INSERT INTO crm_object_sources (
            organization_id,
            provider,
            crm_tenant_id,
            object_api_name,
            external_record_id,
            normalized_entity_type,
            normalized_entity_id,
            crm_connection_id,
            source_user_id,
            mapper_version,
            latest_raw_record_id,
            normalized_at,
            normalized_hash
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2::text::crm_provider,
            $3,
            $4,
            $5,
            $6,
            $7,
            $8,
            $9,
            $10,
            $11,
            COALESCE($12, now()),
            $13
         )
         ON CONFLICT (
            organization_id,
            provider,
            crm_tenant_id,
            object_api_name,
            external_record_id
         )
         DO UPDATE
            SET normalized_entity_type = EXCLUDED.normalized_entity_type,
                normalized_entity_id = EXCLUDED.normalized_entity_id,
                crm_connection_id = EXCLUDED.crm_connection_id,
                source_user_id = EXCLUDED.source_user_id,
                mapper_version = EXCLUDED.mapper_version,
                latest_raw_record_id = EXCLUDED.latest_raw_record_id,
                normalized_at = EXCLUDED.normalized_at,
                normalized_hash = EXCLUDED.normalized_hash,
                updated_at = now()
         RETURNING id
